name: check_room
description: Checks whether a meeting room can be booked for one time slot and answers Available or Unavailable. It only checks: it does not save, create, change or cancel any booking. Every time is a whole number of minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440 (range 0-1440), for example 09:00 = 540, 10:00 = 600, 16:30 = 990, 24:00 = 1440. Convert clock times yourself and never guess a value the user did not give.

start.description: Requested start of the slot, in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440). 10:00 = 600.

end.description: Requested end of the slot, in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440). 24:00 = 1440.

now.description: The current time, in whole minutes since midnight (0-1440).

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked (for example for maintenance), false otherwise.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room on the same day. Use [] if there are none.

start.description: Start of an existing booking, in minutes since midnight.

end.description: End of an existing booking, in minutes since midnight.
